_comment: Index of curify-gallery/ecommerce_ad_videos for SMM distribution (FB Groups + Kuaishou). Drafted 2026-09-06; folder consolidated into 2026-09-01-ecommerce on 2026-09-11. FB copy in posts_fb.md, 快手 copy in posts_kuaishou.md, both keyed by the id field below. fabric_ad added 2026-09-18. clearance drives whether an item may go on a public feed at all -- see README.md (Clearance) and curify-studio/docs/asset-authority-distribution-inventory.md sec 3 group B.

cta.batch_line_en: We do these in batches for catalogs -- one product, a full set of ad cuts. Contact us: curify-ai.com/contact
cta.batch_line_zh: 整个产品线可以批量做 -- 一个 SKU 出一整套广告片。批量合作私信或看主页 curify-ai.com

clearance_tiers.ship: Own or unbranded output. Cleared for public feeds.
clearance_tiers.check: One unresolved question (likeness or source footage provenance). Hold until answered.
clearance_tiers.internal: Third-party trademark or character IP rendered on screen. Internal / investor decks only -- never a public feed. Matches the group-B rule in asset-authority-distribution-inventory.md.

videos.subject: Fictional 'Angry Alert' emotion-detection app; live-action-style office scenes, red HUD overlay on a face
videos.clearance_note: Own fictional product, own output. Curify logo bookend already baked in. Small 'Veo' generator watermark visible in one corner.
videos.hook: An ad for a product that does not exist -- made to show the format, not the app

videos.subject: Iced matcha latte build: falling banana slices, milk pour into layered glass, macro condensation on the finished cup
videos.clearance_note: Fully unbranded. Cleanest asset in the set -- safe on any feed, any market.
videos.hook: No studio, no food stylist, no pour-over take 40

videos.subject: Ergonomic mesh office chair: airflow particle viz through the mesh back, HUD armrest-adjust readout, 360 hero in a styled interior
videos.clearance_note: Unbranded generic chair. Safe. Has an AI-generator sparkle watermark bottom-right.
videos.hook: The feature-explainer shot that normally needs a 3D artist

videos.subject: Cotton-to-garment macro film: ivory cotton boll, twisted yarn with an amber warmth pass, raking view over the charcoal weave, a suspended fabric sheet catching one slow wave, water beads rolling on the slope, closing on a charcoal button-down on a hanger
videos.clearance_note: Own output, own prompt, fully unbranded -- no text, no logo, no mannequin, no human face anywhere in frame. Text-to-video only: the reference-upload attempt was rejected by MiniMax's approval review, so nothing from the two third-party reference ads reached the model. Provenance recorded in agentic-adhoc real-projects 2026-09-18-internal-005-fabric-ad-video. Clearance-wise this is as clean as matcha_drink.
videos.hook: The one thing a listing photo has never been able to show: what the cloth is
videos.orientation_note: 16:9 landscape, like kungfu_sf. FB-ready as-is; needs a 9:16 or 3:4 recut before any vertical feed (Kuaishou, RedNote). Not yet recut -- which is why best_for lists fb_groups only.

videos.subject: Male model in a black suit, full-length, in a marble-and-brass elevator lobby; slow orbit
videos.clearance_note: Unbranded garment, but a photoreal human face. If this was rendered from a pose/likeness reference of a real model, the face may carry that person's likeness -- the documented failure mode in the fashion-model pose-ref note. Confirm the reference was synthetic before any public feed or client deck.
videos.hook: On-model apparel without booking a model

videos.subject: Kungfu figure across SF landmarks -- tiled rooftops with red lanterns, downtown rooftop leap, Golden Gate at sunset with falling autumn leaves
videos.clearance_note: No energy-drink trademark visible in any sampled frame -- the brand lives in the FILENAME only. Rename the file before it leaves the building so the asset name does not imply a tie-in.
videos.hook: Landmark-scale action without a location permit

videos.subject: Desert dig live-action, oil pour into a gold-rim vessel, OILIGHT wordmark-and-flame logo end card
videos.clearance_note: Two open questions: (1) OILIGHT appears to be a real third-party or client brand -- publishing it as our marketing sample needs their written OK, or the client-confidential rule applies; (2) the opening desert footage is live-action with an identifiable person, so it is either licensed stock or someone else's footage. Resolve both before use.

videos.subject: Climber in a blue shell opens a clear beer bottle at a snow summit at sunrise
videos.clearance_note: Corona is a live trademark (Grupo Modelo / AB InBev). Also depicts alcohol, which carries its own ad-policy restrictions on both FB and Kuaishou. Internal only.

videos.subject: Mooncake and a latte on a wooden table, steam rising, warm window light
videos.clearance_note: Starbucks siren logo rendered clearly on the cup. Live trademark. Internal only.

videos.subject: Fairytale forest, a figure in a Snow White gown raises a hand, ice letters spell POPMART
videos.brand_on_screen: POPMART (spelled in ice letters) + Snow White costume likeness
videos.clearance_note: Double exposure -- POP MART is a live trademark AND the Snow White character design reads as Disney. This is the same class as the Labubu print assets that are permanently off the public feed. Internal only.

videos.subject: Pink-silk cosmetic hero: jar on a glass podium, falling diamonds, sunburst backlight, lotus and petals
videos.brand_on_screen: POND'S White Beauty (wordmark on the jar)
videos.clearance_note: POND'S is a live Unilever trademark, rendered legibly on the jar. Internal only. The de-branded re-render in prompts/beauty_cream.json is the publishable replacement.
